remarks: Come see this Amazing Well Loved 2 story home.  Lots of original charm and lovingly cared for.From the Front Entrance you will find the Front Living room with access to the stairway. Off the Living room there is a large Formal Dining room and also Access to another room used to display lots of Art work and also has a door to the side of the house.  This room also has access to the Library which also leads you to the Back Den.  The Den is a cozy room to relax and enjoy Family and Friends.  This room also has access to the Large back deck and green house.  The kitchen has access from the back deck into the mud room, and has additional eat in space if you want an informal eating area.  The kitchen offers lots of space for cooking and prep... Pantry storage and a Bath with a shower and laundry is off the kitchen.  There is also a door into the Den...  Upstairs you will find 5 Bedrooms and one full bath.  The largest back bedroom has a walk in closet, and additional office space or dressing room depending on your needs.  Full bath upstairs has a step in shower.  The other four bedrooms offer lots of space for family and friends.  This property has also been used as a Bed and Breakfast.  The detached garage could hold 3 cars, but one bay has been turned into a work shop area.  This Unique home has lots of possibilities to offer.
